Name: Dragonsir's Rabbit Replacer
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=5]Features[/size]

5 new fur colors for your rabbits:

1. Cottontail- color is from my cottontail rabbit mod.
2. Gray- based on the wild "critter" rabbit that you sometimes see running into bushes in the forest and mountain areas.
3. White- white hair with blue eyes
4. Albino- white hair with red eyes
5. Void- same color scheme as the void chicken

There are 2 versions of the mod:

A. Content Patcher- The default color is Gray. If you have Generic Mod Configuration Menu (MCM) you can change the color in the mod options. Otherwise, you can change the color in the config file, which is generated after running the game once.

B. Alternative Textures- Requires Alternative Textures (AT). Bunnies will be random colors when you buy them from Marnie's. Purchase the scissors from Robin's and use them to change the bunnies' colors.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Install Generic Mod Configuration Menu (optional for CP version).[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Install Alternative Textures (required for AT version only).[/url]﻿
[*]Download ONE of the main files of this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
